script: (() => { const g = window.__ns.game; g.startPlaying(true); g.hud.helpQueue = []; g.hud.helpT = 0.01; g.simulate(0.3); const L = g.layout; const P = L.poi('carwash'); const b = L.blocks[P.block]; const inn = L.inner(b); const cx = (inn.x0 + inn.x1) / 2; const v = g.traffic.spawnVehicle(g.vehicleDefs.falcon, cx + 4, inn.z0 + 27, Math.PI / 2 + 0.25, { color: '#ecebe6' }); g.refCar = v; g.player.pos.set(cx + 2.2, 0.15, inn.z0 + 29.6); g.player.yaw = Math.PI * 0.62; g.cam.mode = 'near'; g.cam.yaw = Math.PI * 0.62; g.cam.pitch = 0.13; g.simulate(1.0); return [b.style, inn.x0, inn.z0, inn.x1, inn.z1]; })()

(() => { const g = window.__ns.game; if (g.refCar) g.traffic.removeVehicle ? g.traffic.removeVehicle(g.refCar) : 0; const L = g.layout; const r = L.zs[10]; const x = (L.xs[6].pos + L.xs[7].pos) / 2; const v = g.traffic.spawnVehicle(g.vehicleDefs.roadster, x - 60, r.pos + 2.25, Math.PI / 2, { color: '#ecebe6' }); const d = v.doorPoint(1); g.player.pos.set(d.x, 0.15, d.z); g.simulate(0.2); g.simulate(2.5, [], ['KeyF']); g.simulate(3.0, ['KeyW']); return g.debugState(); })()

(() => { const g = window.__ns.game; g.simulate(2, ['KeyS']); g.exitVehicleNow(); g.simulate(0.4); const L = g.layout; const P = L.poi('church'); const b = L.blocks[P.block]; const inn = L.inner(b); g.player.pos.set(inn.x1 + 2.0, 0.15, inn.z1 - 34); g.player.yaw = 0.12; g.cam.mode = 'mid'; g.cam.yaw = 0.12; g.cam.pitch = 0.13; g.simulate(1.6, ['KeyW']); return [b.style, inn.x1, inn.z1, b.sw]; })()
